dialogs.about: 손자에게 급할 때 전화하는 방법을 알려줘요

lines.en: Grandma, what do I do in an emergency?
lines.ko: 할머니, 급한 일이 생기면 어떻게 해요?

lines.en: First, stay calm. Then dial one one nine.
lines.ko: 먼저 마음을 가라앉혀요. 그다음에 일일구를 눌러요.

lines.en: Will an ambulance come fast?
Yes. It will come in a few minutes.
lines.ko: 네. 몇 분 안에 올 거예요.

lines.en: What if someone has a small burn?
Put it under cool water. Do you understand?
Yes. I cut my finger last week. It bled.
lines.ko: 네. 지난주에 손가락을 베었어요. 피가 났어요.

lines.en: I remember. Then we washed the wound well.
You are a good nurse, Grandma!
Thank you. Now let's write the number down.
lines.ko: 고마워요. 이제 그 번호를 적어 둬요.

dialogs.about: 응급실 접수대에서 간호사에게 이웃의 안부를 물어요

lines.en: Excuse me. My neighbor came here this morning.
lines.ko: 실례해요. 이웃이 오늘 아침에 여기 왔어요.

lines.en: Yes. She is fine now. Please don't worry.
Thank you. Did she faint in the garden?
She felt weak for a while, that's all.
Was it urgent?
A little, so we called the ambulance then.
Did she have a wound or a burn?
No bleeding at all. Her heart is strong.
lines.ko: 피도 전혀 안 났어요. 심장도 튼튼해요.

lines.en: I'm so glad. When will she go home?
After lunch. Please dial this number for news.
lines.ko: 점심 후에요. 소식은 이 번호로 전화해 주세요.
